instruction: In the call (combine (parse input) (validate schema) (transform rules)), swap the first and third arguments so it becomes (combine (transform rules) (validate schema) (parse input)).
input:
(define (pipeline input schema rules)
  (combine
    (parse input)
    (validate schema)
    (transform rules)))
expected: (define (pipeline input schema rules) (combine (transform rules) (validate schema) (parse input)))
